newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber higher on Palembang deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber higher on Palembang deal.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were higher in noon trading on Wednesday following deals in Palembang, traders said.
"Offer prices are going up after the deals in Palembang. But demand is still generally low," one trader said.
Traders said Singapore dealers bought 200 tonnes of August shipment SIR20 at 48.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang overnight.
They said offer prices were quoted at 48.25 cents/lb fob Medan, 48.366 fob Surabaya, 48.00 fob Padang, 47.75 fob Jambi and 47.50 fob Pontianak.
Traders said supply was a little tight in Medan because many tappers had switched to other jobs when rubber prices were considered low by them.
